subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat implement only the core Copy and Select Copy actions first, or include Share and Reply in the same long-press message menu?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue proposes four actions and prior PR review found Reply semantics could be misleading unless message context is actually sent, so implementation should wait for product scope.

options.title: Copy/Select First
options.body: Implement a narrow long-press menu for whole-message copy and selectable text, leaving Share and Reply for follow-up after the core clipboard UX is proven.

options.title: Full Action Sheet
options.body: Implement Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting the extra reply-context and share-sheet behavior that must be designed and proven before merge.

options.title: Adopt Linked Fork Path
options.body: Review the open fork PR as the starting point if maintainers want to preserve that contributor work, but require refresh against current ChatScreen paths and real Android proof.

recommendation.title: Copy/Select First
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow long-press menu for whole-message copy and selectable text, leaving Share and Reply for follow-up after the core clipboard UX is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent history signal across Android chat Markdown and adjacent message UI work, and merged the related link-annotation fix.
